original_text: Audio batch 06 — playback handling reminder: if the LT player never starts, including a visible waveform with no playback, report the task ID, browser/error state, and whether another clip plays. Treat this as a tool incident. Do not score unavailable audio as a model-quality failure or choose content QN solely because playback is unavailable. This is handling guidance, not confirmation that the player has been fixed; retain the details needed to reproduce the incident.
